answer: To enroll, each agent must appear at one public registration wharf and lock a walnut of unshared collateral to a single identity key. After enrollment, a recurring comet audit scores clustering among keys that sign in tight bursts or reuse funding paths. Any two keys that share a funding source, a bond serial, or a high comet cluster score forfeit every linked walnut and lose emission rights. Standing up N sybil identities therefore requires N separate bonds and uncorrelated funding and timing; reused capital or coordinated signing burns the farm's locked stake.
